rubrics.justification: The model explicitly stated no image was provided and did not fabricate embryo morphology; therefore it avoided inaccurate morphological claims.

It integrated age, ovarian reserve, PCOS, endometrium, sperm, smoking, and prior ectopic well, though some links to actual embryo quality were necessarily hypothetical because morphology was unavailable.
The reasoning is structured and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to favorable age/reserve and negative smoking history; the estimate is conditional on assumed good-quality blastocyst.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based (smoking cessation, standard luteal support, embryo selection by morphology/PGT if available, caution with PCOS), though PGT-A at age 32 is more optional than routinely indicated.
Provides practical next steps for current transfer and future planning, especially smoking cessation and lifestyle optimization, though some advice remains somewhat general.
